method: Bytes pulled with `git show <head>:<path>` (no checkout) into a scratch tree and SHA-256 hashed there; no catalogue, English, ledger, allowance or generated file was edited. English, French and the English context sidecar were read side by side for the whole namespace, not just the delta. ICU was parsed with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser 3.5.21 (argument names, argument types, plural categories and selectors, number skeletons, tags) and rendered with intl-messageformat 12.1.3 under locale fr by a read-only Node probe against the repository's own node_modules. Key sets and order were compared per namespace; every maxCells hint in the sidecar was measured against the French value (code-point cells); register and glossary were checked against the core glossary and the fr style guide, and the locale's key terms were grepped across the whole fr catalogue for drift.
instance_note: One run per namespace, unique to this namespace by sha256(en bytes + en context bytes + fr bytes), first 12 hex; distinct from the round-2 extract audit da12aa6ade20, which predates the final keys.

width: new_chat is 21 cells against a 16-cell advisory (2.62x the 8-cell English) and new_chat_with is 35 against 32 (27-cell literal prefix vs 14 in English, plus {target}). The advisory is explicitly 'not measured fit'. Accepted, not shortened: (1) the key is the header title that stands in for arbitrary conversation names, and the h2 is `min-w-0 max-w-full truncate` (chat-header.tsx, head), so a long value ellipsizes instead of breaking the row; (2) the app's declared minimum window is WINDOW_MIN_WIDTH = 800 (src/main/window-mode.ts), and at the 560px design frame the 20-character English stand-in still ends before the identity chip, so 21 characters fit at the real minimum with room; (3) the only <=16-cell alternatives are « Nouveau chat » (12) or an abbreviation, both of which contradict the locale's settled term for chat (conversation, 292 occurrences) and the control label the same header sits beside. No rendered French frame was captured in this session; the pixel claim above is read from the existing 560px design frame at ~/.local-operator/sessions/a444fd0978dd/scratchpad/design-1403/fr/device-560.webp, not from a French render of this key.
